description: You and your two siblings share the cost of medications for your elderly mother. Open the text file at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/med_receipts_november.txt containing messy receipt data from last month. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/november_med_reconciliation.xlsx that: (1) Lists all 8 medication purchases with Date, Purchaser, Pharmacy, Medication, and Cost columns; (2) Calculates total monthly expense; (3) Shows equal 3-way split amount per person; (4) Calculates individual payment totals for Mike, Sarah, and You; (5) Shows balance (who owes whom) for each person; (6) Flags any purchase over $75 as 'High Cost - Discuss'. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
